Commentary.Commentary: The action continues in the Super Sixes. On 1st July, Scotland will face the Windies at 12.30 pm IST (7 am GMT). Join us for the coverage. Cheers!

Dasun Shanaka says he is happy to cross the line. Shares they have the skill with the bat but played a few bad shots. Reckons it was a masterclass from Dhananjaya de Silva and he deserved a ton. Even Maheesh Theekshana batted well. Admits they always believed they could defend as they had the power with the ball. On Lahiru Kumara, Dasun Shanaka says they are assessing his injury.

Scott Edwards says he is disappointed as at the halfway mark they were in the game but they just couldn't bat well. Adds they bowled well but Dhananjaya de Silva played exceptionally well. Reckons they should have crossed the line but this is cricket. Tells he plays according to the field. Admits they believed that they could chase this down right till the end.
...Presentation next...

Dhananjaya de Silva wins the Player of the Match. He says he just tried to play the loose balls and make sure to stay till the end, got good support from Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana with the bat. Reckons he loves to bat and he got the opportunity today. Shares they are doing well in all three departments and are looking forward to the next match.

Credit to Scott Edwards for the way he batted. He needed someone to support from the other end. The batters didn't do much but the tail did help for a while but not for long. Sri Lanka have one man to thank, Dhananjaya de Silva. He made sure Sri Lanka get to a competitive total. Sri Lanka wouldn't have even got to 200 but Dhananjaya de Silva's knock probably gave Sri Lanka a fighting chance.

Sri Lanka have done it! What a game! Sri Lanka have defended the low score but they had heart in their mouth right till the end as Edwards kept the hopes alive throughout. Sri Lanka have made a habit to take wickets for fun but this time they had the pressure as had slightly fewer runs on the board. Netherlands didn't start well. They lost both openers in two overs but got a solid stand in Wesley Barresi and Bas de Leede. At one moment, it looked like Netherlands will chase this down with ease but then came the mystery spinners. Maheesh Theekshana in particular who changed the course of the game. Wanindu Hasaranga was at his best yet again.
OUT! BOWLED! The skipper stands up! A length ball on off, bit of reverse swing. Dutt defends inside the line and is beaten. It rolls through and hits the stumps. Sri Lanka win by 21 runs.
